a D = 5 Chern–Simons theory can be used to derive a D = 4 WZW theory, which is a special case of the WZW theory in any D = 4 + 1 dimension.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the CS functional in 4 + 1 dimensions can be regarded as the bulk of a 3 + 1 dimensional gauge theory with the 4D WZW functional on its boundary.
the CS functional is a bulk-boundary theory, not just a gauge theory.
the WZW functional in 4D is not a gauge invariant term, but rather a gauge invariant functional of a gauge theory in D = 5.
